sources.entry: blender-kiln by elithril - A Claude Code plugin that drives Blender over an MCP server to turn a text brief or a reference photo into an optimized, validated GLB: scripted modeling measured against the photo, textures from CC0 scans, a joint-by-joint review, Draco/WebP export.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code skill that drives Blender through an MCP server to turn a text brief or a reference photo into an optimized, validated GLB using scripted modeling, CC0 scan textures and measured fidelity checks.
use_cases: Turning a text description into a web-ready 3D prop
Rebuilding a real object from a single reference photo
Compressing Blender exports to small GLB files
Sourcing CC0 PBR textures for a Blender model
Checking a 3D model's silhouette against a reference image
Rigging and animating simple props or characters in Blender
how_to_run: /kiln A hanging iron lantern for a medieval inn, stylized, for the web
stack: Blender MCP (ahujasid mcp-for-blender or Blender Foundation Lab MCP)
notable: Photo-based rebuild measured against the real object: silhouette overlap per height band, materials and joint close-ups via fidelity_check.py
Textures chosen from Poly Haven CC0 scan sets rather than procedural noise
Works with both ahujasid's mcp-for-blender and the official Blender Lab MCP
Re-measures the shipped GLB after Draco/WebP compression, not just the .blend
Animation routed by subject: scripted quadruped cycles, UniMate text-to-motion for bipeds, keyed rigid parts for articulated props
caveats: Requires Blender 4.4 or newer with a Blender MCP addon running on port 9876; 4.4-4.5 are untested
Optional AI generation depends on free Hugging Face Spaces with tight ZeroGPU quotas; Hunyuan3D licence excludes EU, UK and South Korea
UniMate checkpoints are CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial only); Sketchfab needs a free API token
